definitions.explanation: Describes a person who tends not to trust others or who is inclined to doubt what they are told. Formed from 疑い (doubt) + 深い (deep).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い{性格|せいかく}だ。
{疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い{目|め}でこちらを{見|み}ている。
examples.english: He's looking at us with suspicious eyes.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}いから、{簡単|かんたん}には{信|しん}じてくれないだろう。
examples.english: That person is so skeptical that they probably won't believe us easily.

notes:
FORMATION:
Follows the productive ～{深|ぶか}い pattern meaning "deeply inclined toward ~": {用心|ようじん}{深|ぶか}い (cautious), {信仰|しんこう}{深|ぶか}い (devout), {嫉妬|しっと}{深|ぶか}い (jealous).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い{性格|せいかく} (a distrustful personality)
- {疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い{目|め} (suspicious eyes)
- {疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い{人|ひと} (a skeptical person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {猜疑|さいぎ}{心|しん}が{強|つよ}い: suspicious-natured — more formal, emphasizes paranoia
- {懐疑的|かいぎてき}: skeptical — more formal/academic, used for intellectual doubt
- {用心|ようじん}{深|ぶか}い: cautious — focuses on carefulness rather than distrust
